cases.context:
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped ProbabilityTheory
definition_context: Measure A assigns nonnegative extended real masses to measurable sets. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. ρ.real s is the real-valued conversion of ρ s and equals the usual real mass on finite events.

Kernel A B is a measurable assignment of measures on B to points of A. IsMarkovKernel means every assigned measure has total mass one. K ∘ₘ ρ is measure–kernel composition: on a measurable t it is the nonnegative integral of x ↦ K x t under ρ.
cases.statement:
example
    {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    (μ ν : Measure A) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (K : Kernel A B) [IsMarkovKernel K]
    {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → |μ.real s - ν.real s| ≤ δ) :
    ∀ t, MeasurableSet t →
      |(K ∘ₘ μ).real t - (K ∘ₘ ν).real t| ≤ δ
